title: Mobile APK readiness — corporate / kitchen / delivery
purpose: Evaluate web structure maturity and business-logic maturity for Android APK preparation across the three field/customer roles.

web_structure: Auth surface for clients (session vs token API)
business_logic: Domain extraction into Support/services (not trapped in Livewire)

architecture_baseline.pattern: Laravel 13 + Livewire 4 monolith; domain in app/Support/*
architecture_baseline.auth_mobile: Sanctum bearer tokens — corporate only today
architecture_baseline.existing_native: mobile/corporate Flutter app; release APK artifact at mobile/corporate/releases/middo-corporate-release.apk

corporate.apk_path: Flutter already ships; continue hardening API parity + push

evidence: Dedicated web portal routes/web/corporates.php under /corporate (auth + role:corporate)
Full Sanctum REST surface routes/api/corporate.php (~30 endpoints) + CorporateMobileController (~1545 LOC)
CorporateApiPresenter + shared Support services used by web and API (cancel, packages, wallet, prepay)
Flutter app mobile/corporate with go_router shell, Sanctum AuthStore, FCM device tokens
Web↔mobile parity tests (WebMobileParityTest, Feature/Api/CorporateMobileApiTest)
Release APK build path documented in mobile/corporate/README.md
gaps: Corporate web uses public site layout (layouts.public.app), not a staff PWA shell — irrelevant for APK since Flutter is the mobile client
CorporateMobileController is a large single controller; further extraction would ease maintenance, not block APK

evidence: Ordering, OTP, gateway prepay, packages/subscriptions, wallet top-up, cancel/skip, track, support, box ready-for-pickup all wired through Support classes
OrderCancellation, PackageRefund, OrderPaymentMethod, CorporateOrderPrepayment shared by web + API (BL hunt remediations applied)
FCM push on status change via SendOrderStatusPush / OrderObserver
Cutoff / editability (OrderCutoff, isEditableByCorporate)
gaps: BL-PERMISSION-PIVOT still deferred (role gates dominate; no Policies)
Status machine is light string guard (OrderTransition), not a formal enum/state machine
Some package / multi-date edge cases historically fragile — covered by tests but worth regression vigilance before store release

recommended_next: Treat corporate APK as production path; focus on release QA, store listing, and API contract freeze
Optional: split CorporateMobileController by resource for maintainability
Keep WebMobileParityTest green whenever checkout/wallet/package rules change

kitchen.apk_path: Phase B Sanctum /api/kitchen/* foundation landed (auth, dashboard, alerts, groups, active orders, menus, boxes list). Continue remaining money/dispatch/FCM + Flutter client. PWA remains interim Android path.

evidence: Complete role portal routes/web/kitchen.php with permission:kitchen.* matrix (KitchenPermissions)
Rich Livewire surface (Dashboard, MiddoOrderGroups, ActiveOrders, Dispatch, menus/recipes, prep shopping list, boxes, cash handovers, account, complaints, profile)
Thumbs-first shell resources/views/components/kitchen/layout/* (bottom nav, more-sheet, safe-area)
Installable PWA manifest-kitchen.webmanifest (standalone, portrait)
KitchenAppShellTest + e2e/kitchen.spec.ts
Completion backlog K0–K6 marked done (docs/kitchen-completion-todo.json)
gaps: Phase B foundation exists (routes/api/kitchen.php + KitchenMobileController + KitchenApiPresenter + KitchenMobileApiTest) — money, dispatch modal, prep shopping list, complaints, incoming boxes still follow-up
No kitchen FCM / device-token push pipeline yet (registration endpoint exists; StaffAlerts are still DB-only)
Native Flutter client (mobile/kitchen/) not started
Livewire still owns some orchestration (e.g. DispatchOrderModal) — extract before /orders/{id}/dispatch API

evidence: Accept window, capacity/tiers, decline/shortage/release, ready vs pack/dispatch split (OrderGroupKitchenAssignment, OrderKitchenAcceptance, OrderKitchenActions, KitchenAcceptWindow, KitchenCapacity)
Box custody + damage + requests (MiddoBoxKitchenActions, KitchenBoxStock, KitchenBoxRequestFlow)
Kitchen money: dispatch credits, cash-handover debits, withdrawals, transfer to Middo (KitchenMoneyService, KitchenAccountLedger)
Prep shopping list from recipes (KitchenIngredientRollup)
Complaints inbox (KitchenComplaints)
Broad Feature/Kitchen test suite covering K1–K6 themes
gaps: Some transitions/actions still orchestrated inside Livewire components — extract action facades before API to avoid HTML-coupled logic
No kitchen push channel yet for accept-window / new-group alerts (field cooks need OS notifications on APK)
Permission model exists for kitchen web; API would need the same permission checks, not role-only

recommended_next_for_apk: Phase A: freeze kitchen IA screen list from bottom-nav (dashboard, groups, active orders, boxes, account, more)
Phase B: introduce /api/kitchen/* Sanctum API mirroring Support entry points (accept/decline/release/ready/dispatch/boxes/cash/account)
Phase C: Flutter or Cap/TWA client; prefer Flutter only if offline/camera/scan needs exceed PWA
Until then: treat Kitchen PWA as the Android delivery vehicle (Add to Home Screen / Trusted Web Activity optional)

delivery.apk_path: PWA is intentional foundation for later native; native APK needs /api/delivery Sanctum + push

evidence: Portal routes/web/deliveryman.php under /delivery (auth + role:delivery)
Livewire: Dashboard (shift), KitchenDispatches, PendingBoxRuns, DeliveredOrders+PaymentModal, CashHandovers, CustomRuns, Account, alerts
R5 thumbs-first shell resources/views/components/delivery/layout/* + DeliveryMobileShellR5Test
PWA manifest-delivery.webmanifest (Middo Rider)
Rider backlog R0–R6 done (one partial commission leg); docs note shell is foundation for later native app
e2e/delivery.spec.ts + extensive Feature/Delivery money/SLA tests
gaps: No /api/delivery JSON API
No Sanctum token auth for riders
No rider FCM device-token / push job (parcel calls are StaffAlerts + area scope)
Routes do not use fine-grained permission: middleware (role-only); native API should still enforce DeliveryAreaScope + RiderShift + ownership
Field needs: background location optional, reliable offline claim/deliver — neither in web stack today

evidence: Area-scoped runs (DeliveryAreaScope), shift gate (RiderShift), accept SLA (RiderAcceptSla)
Hybrid commission model (RiderCommission + OrderMoneyFlow at run start); cash due UX (collect − commission = due) via RiderMoneyService / CashHandoverActions
Order transitions for claim → pickup → deliver → settle via OrderTransition
Custom runs R2b; box runs; wallet withdrawals
Strong Feature/Delivery coverage (R0–R6, N1 shifts, N3 partial cash)
gaps: R2.3 partial: kitchen→ops box commission deferred until rider-mediated kitchen→warehouse leg exists
Livewire still orchestrates multi-step cash/box flows — need thin API controllers over Support before APK
No formal Policies; ownership checks are inline — acceptable if copied carefully into API middleware

recommended_next_for_apk: Phase A: document rider screen IA from R5 bottom-nav as native IA contract
Phase B: /api/delivery/* Sanctum API — claim, pickup, deliver, settle, box runs, cash handover, account, shift, alerts
Phase C: FCM for new parcel calls / SLA (reuse device_tokens + FcmClient pattern from corporate)
Phase D: Flutter rider app (mirror corporate) or enhance PWA→TWA if GPS/offline not required yet
Close R2.3 when kitchen→ops rider leg is productized

comparative_summary.blocker_for_apk: API foundation started; still need money/dispatch endpoints, FCM, Flutter client
no token API + no push; domain is Livewire/PWA

strengths: Business logic for all three roles is largely mature in app/Support and covered by role completion backlogs (kitchen K0–K6, rider R0–R6)
Canonical order transitions exist (OrderTransition) and money/box side effects are centralized enough to wrap in APIs
Corporate proves the APK pattern: Sanctum + presenter + Flutter + FCM + parity tests
Kitchen/delivery already have mobile IA (bottom nav PWA) — good screen contracts for future native apps
structural_risks_for_apk: Kitchen/delivery logic still partially lives in Livewire action methods with direct Eloquent — API work should extract/call Support, not scrape Livewire
No Policies/Gates — API must re-apply role, permission (kitchen), area/shift/ownership (delivery) consistently
Realtime is weak outside corporate FCM; field roles will feel stale without push or polling strategy
HTTPS-forced app + session cookies are fine for PWA; native APK must use Sanctum (or equivalent), not cookie scraping
recommended_program_order: 1. Keep shipping corporate APK; freeze /api/corporate contract
2. Prefer Kitchen/Delivery PWA (or TWA wrapper APK) as interim Android distribution — web structure already mobile-shaped
3. When native is required: Delivery API first (field offline pressure), then Kitchen API — both cloning corporate Sanctum+FCM pattern
4. Before each role API: extract remaining Livewire-only mutations into Support action classes; add API feature tests parallel to Livewire tests
